fusions.name: Between the Plates
fusions.desc: A thrust through the gap that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Horn Prick
fusions.desc: Jabs at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Sharpened Eye
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Finds the Gap
fusions.desc: Your piercing blows ignore 15% of armour. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
